items.text: New update! This version is packed with improvements for the touch and controller experience, a good number of bug fixes, and some new gameplay features. Here's the breakdown.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/63658770253367b3ba5eaa57dad304f520dfc682.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/fdcc893b740935a2631b3a0093142423dc217e04.png"]

Challenge system for rebel provinces. Rebellions now operate on a pressure system instead of being random. More information about rebellions on this devblog and challenges can be found on this devblog.
Troops have their maximum stats reduced upon entering a rebellion, adjusting to the maximum level allowed in that kingdom.
Reset button on the battle exit screen, allowing you to restart the map without having to exit completely. (Suggested by Dave Osborne)
Visual guide to touch shortcuts in the shortcuts menu, with an image showing all the touchscreen controls.
Contextual help text in combat: if you haven't done anything for 5 seconds, prompts with the most useful buttons appear. (Suggested by Laggimus Prime)
Credits button on the title screen.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/2f5ef5c536d2714c95cb1fa418cd0205d9190add.gif"]
Stars are now displayed even if you lose the map, so you can see how you've done.
Font size and Skill Tree elements increased when "Scale UI" is enabled. (Anonymous feedback)
Spell colors updated (heal, speed, and disable) to be more intuitive and easier to identify. (Suggested by Dave Osborne)
White borders appear on cards, routes, and buttons when hovering over or interacting with them (pause, speed, waves, leave combat). (Suggested by Dave Osborne and Laggimus Prime)
Cards are now rotated when choosing building upgrades, so you can see troop icons, divisions, and descriptions before making your decision. (Suggested by Dave Osborne)
Card display time increased from 3 to 5 seconds with the controller.
Exclamation marks on the troop selector removed when using the controller and replaced with explanatory text at the bottom. (Suggested by Laggimus Prime)
Improved joystick camera. (Suggested by Laggimus Prime)
Improved joystick spellcasting.
Redesigned touch-based spellcasting system: Select the spell, move your finger to aim, and release to cast. No more accidental casts.
Optimized touch response: The touch slop value has been adjusted to eliminate ambiguity between taps and swipes. (Anonymous feedback)
Building conquest upgrades now require a double tap on touch, allowing you to review cards before confirming.
More information about several of these changes can be found in this devblog.
Ghost troop indicators in the selector (showed troops you couldn't select).
Waves could get stuck.
The Army Setup button sometimes didn't place the correct troops.
The Go to Battle button occasionally got stuck. (Reported by Dave Osborne)
Cards would abruptly return to their original position on touch.
When deleting a save file and starting a new one in the same slot, the new save file inherited data from the previous one (causing defenses to do more damage than intended).

The game has been reviewed and rewritten internally from the ground up, with a special focus on the wind and shadow systems. The result: fewer strange bugs and noticeably better performance. In my tests, I saw an improvement of between 5 and 15 FPS on less powerful systems.
Thanks to everyone who reported bugs and suggested improvements!
Fixes

Fixed a bug where unit cooldowns were being carried over between waves. This caused some troops in the new wave to spawn much later than intended, and in certain cases the wave could end prematurely before all units were summoned.
(Reported by: "ESDave")
Fixed an issue where upgrade progress was not being counted correctly, preventing the achievement "At my signal, unleash hell." from unlocking.
(Reported by: "ESDave" and "FresherWater")
During the Toledo Matsuri in-person event, I was able to spot some bugs and notice that certain elements needed adjustments to improve the player experience.
This quick and small update is intended to fix the issues I observed during the event and also to introduce an improvement focused on the upgrade menus when capturing a building.

The improvement makes it so that, when the camera is zoomed out, the upgrade menu automatically scales up as well, allowing for better visibility. Additionally, I’ve added some visual feedback when hovering over the buttons, which was previously missing. Here’s a quick look at that change (este cambio fue propuesto hace tiempo por "McStuffins T. Fox"):

notes.title: Here’s a list of the changes made in this update

items.text: The Necromancer had a bug that prevented it from summoning troops.
Anti-air defenses, the "Needles", did not speed up along with the game speed.
The "exit match" button removed the dark overlay of the pause screen.
Upgrade menus when capturing a building now also scale up when the camera is zoomed out, making them easier to see.
Upgrade buttons are now highlighted when you hover over them.
Upgrade descriptions now appear regardless of which of the three options you are selecting.
Continuously pressing the "Cancel Invasion" button would cause the game to freeze.
The "Shinigami" skin from the Toledo Matsuri event had a bug and couldn’t be obtained.
Spell cooldown numbers were not visible in Realm 5 (Nevura); they’ve been changed to appear in black.
Flag numbers were also not visible in Realm 5 (Nevura); they’ve been changed to appear in black.
Some bushes had incorrect depth values, causing them to appear over other objects in the scene.
The defense stats panel would appear even when the final menu or camera mode was active.
The upcoming 1.4.0 update is on its way and will bring improvements and new features.

notes.title: Mini Expansion Focused on the Lich's Journey

items.text: The new update will include a mini expansion called "The Search", where the Lich embarks on a journey in pursuit of a powerful artifact rumored to elevate his powers. Get ready to help the Lich on his quest! This content is designed to expand the game's ending.
Not only will I focus on new features, but I also plan to spend time polishing all of the current game content, ensuring that every gameplay experience is smoother and more enjoyable than ever.

In this update, I will rebalance troops and defenses as needed, adding or tweaking certain abilities to make battles even more strategic and engaging. This adjustment aims to improve balance and provide more options for every encounter.
I will continue working to improve the game's aesthetics with adjustments and visual enhancements across several key areas.

I've been reading all the reviews and opinions from players to understand what matters most and where I should focus my efforts. But if you have more suggestions on what I should tweak or where I should concentrate, I'll be happy to hear them in the comments. Your feedback is essential to the ongoing improvement of Countless Army.
This update is scheduled to arrive in April.
Stay tuned for more details and get ready for what's coming!

items.text: These fixes address the errors reported during this week following the launch of the Halloween event (1.2.0).
In the map "Cuerno Island," there is a path to rare items at the end (reported by "Jesus101").
One of the maps in the 6th kingdom could not be replayed (reported by "Biscark").
The troops: Banshee, Standard Bearer, Observer, Mass and Necromancer displayed different classes in different locations (reported by "idiot5k").
An error in the map "The Confluence" had an issue with route 2, the one with the mills (it was not well defined) (reported by "idiot5k").
The achievements related to map difficulty only unlocked if you right-clicked with the mouse and not with any other button in the victory menu.
The cannon did not fire when the game was at speed x6.
The achievements for difficulty by capital were not activated.

Regarding the last fix, I am not entirely sure it has been resolved, as it is an error that, no matter how much I try to fix, I cannot seem to solve. However, on this last occasion, I was testing several things, and thanks to a user ("Tekarin"), I was able to confirm that the error comes from the capital of Kingdom 3. Apparently, the data for which level you completed this capital is not being saved correctly.

If it is still not fixed, I would greatly appreciate it if you could report it to me again. I would also like to mention that if I have not managed to fix it yet, you can unlock those achievements by replaying the capital of Kingdom 3 one last time, as even if the data is not saved, you would meet the requirements to achieve the achievements within the same game session.

items.text: The yellow brick road.
Perfectly balanced, as all things should be.
Dead men tell no tales… They make them.
After checking, they were active only for those who saved in file 2. I am making this hotfix to fix that bug and make everyone able to get them.
If you want to get the achievements, you may have to go through the capitals again.
Today the version 1.1.3 of Countless Army is released, a little hotfix to the biggest errors that you all reported.

This one is focused on fixing the bugs that could make the game crash or that don’t allow you to play the game correctly. I’m reading everything you write and taking notes of the faults, even the ones that are little to fix them, but I’m doing it in order. I’m also reading all of your opinions and shortly I’ll post a new notice talking about the things the version 1.2 will bring. I’ve readed a lot of good ideas!
I’ve changed the way the game is compilated, this should make it be better optimized, allowing it to work in each dispositive and give less non consistent errors.
The speed x8 that unlocks in the end game has been changed to x 6. The x8 made a lot of error(is still in test, it can give some errors but less than the x8).
The drake has an error when you summoned it, making everything after it to not be summoned.
The necromancer had the CD wrong when you summoned it.
The drake icon wasn’t visible in the upgrades from the conquerable buildings.
In the capital of the kingdom 2 the 2nd runic camp was conquered when the troops walked over the route on it.
A visual bug where the shields appears under the troop.
The tutorial sometimes crashed on the first wave.
The necromancer could make the game crash if he made a summon when he entered to conquer a building.
The mass could crash the game if died when he entered a building.

The tutorial didn’t get the golden skull if you have the map in 100%(don’t worry, if you get the golden skill in the other maps the tutorial one will change to gold for the achievement of getting all the maps to 100%).
Sometimes when you realize any action in an invasion the wave sign could disappear making it impossible to start a new wave.
The troops count to win a map could be negative.
The dragon could die in the defense “trench” of one hit.
Again, thanks a lot to all for reporting the bugs and for adding suggestions, it helps me a lot!

Hi again!

Today I bring another fast update to fix a bug that I’ve been informed is preventing the tutorial from advancing in easy difficulty. I’m also working in the friday update, however some things that you’ll have from now:

Hello!

I’ve had some complaints about the difficulty, and even if I want a game that is a little complicated, I don’t want to leave people without playing Countless Army because of this. For this reason and even if a big update is coming on the freeday, I want to bring you this quick update to fix it.
Added an option to change letters font.
Added an option to choose game difficulty. Being able to play in easy(-40% damage), normal(the current version of the game) and hard(+20% damage).
The first two maps have been changed to be more accessible. They weren’t impossible but not for much.
I recommend playing the easy difficulty for those that aren’t very familiar with strategy games or to people that can’t get through the normal difficulty.
The normal difficulty is the one in which the game was designed originally and is the one in which I think the game has to be played.
The hard difficulty is not fully tested, so I’m working on it.
Even the difficulty and the letters font can be changed in the option menu in any moment:
Besides this you have to choose a difficulty at the start of each game:
I hope this gets better access to new players.
I love to receive your comments about the new difficulty modes, to know if they are balanced or are very easy/very hard to balance them better.
See you in the next update!
Before showing the game to many people, I received comments about the visual noise that existed in the game, and for that I've been working on improving that part, finally I can show it.

The noise has been reduced from each scenario, the road is simplified to make them more clear, and generally speaking, the design has been improved to have less noise, making it more clear-cut and visually less fuzzy.
Soon you’ll have this change and many more in the last demo, that comes close to the game launch!

The cards now show their back side to show that they aren’t usable at that moment.

Changes on the tutorial from the old one, to be lighter and more enjoyable, being able to skip it at any moment.
Added Lich’s flag at the beginning of the paths, to have them as a fast reference about where the troops are going to conquer the map.
Bug fixes
Hi!
Today I came to show some updates to the Demo, you can try them already in the game.
I balanced the first kingdom, to make the difficulty more suitable to an “introduction” to the game. This way this kingdom offers a better experience.
The tutorial now is shorter, now it takes half of the time and it is “lighter”.
Some visual effects were added, to give more immersion to the world. The first one if the climate.
The second: fishes. They are on the rivers to give them more life, and aslo some new effects were added to the water.
Also, some bugs that I found were fixed, and other changes to make yout gaming experience better.
At the same time, I’ve been working on the balance of the 2nd kingdom and the creation of the 3th kingdom, soon I’ll bring another update where I’ll show something of it.
For the moment, here is where the update ends, I hope that everyone than plays it like it and I’m waiting for you to tell me how it looks!
